# Generate candidate: recolor component only if any axis crosses its bounding box interior, or both axes touch it.
out2=[row[:] for row in orig]
for comp in comps:
 rs=[x for x,y in comp]; cs=[y for x,y in comp]
 axes=[(x in (4,11), y==5) for x,y in comp]
 hit_h=any(x in (4,11) for x,y in comp); hit_v=any(y==5 for x,y in comp)
 inside_h=any(min(rs)<r<max(rs) for r in (4,11) if r in rs)
 inside_v=(min(cs)<5<max(cs)) and any(y==5 for x,y in comp)
 if inside_h or inside_v or (hit_h and hit_v):
  for x,y in comp: out2[x][y]=1
for r in range(R):

  if r in (4,11) or c==5: out2[r][c]=1
print(json.dumps(out2,separators=(',',':')))
